content:
Let \(x\) be the number of tea bags.

For Natasha, with \(x\) bags, possible total cups range from \(2x\) to \(3x\). Thus
\[
2x \le 41 \le 3x \implies 14 \le x \le 20.
\]
For Inna,
\[
2x \le 58 \le 3x \implies 20 \le x \le 29.
\]
The only common integer is \(x=20\).

Check: \(20\) bags can make \(41=19\cdot2+1\cdot3\) and \(58=2\cdot2+18\cdot3\).

\[
\boxed{20}
\]
